patch_list: TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Android 16 HyperOS Black Bars
Android 16 phones show an AMOLED-black status bar with white icons; tablets retain their immersive behavior.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Expand Behind Status Bar
Preserves top-edge layout across two TV360 UI resets; does not move content behind bottom navigation.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Experimental Picture in Picture
Auto-enter Android 12+ PiP only when the Alticast player reports active playback; requires device testing.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Hide Status Bar
Requests status-bar-only hiding on Android 15 and reapplies it when TV360 resumes; keeps bottom navigation.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - My Media3 Player
Adds a visible top-right Media3 launcher for HTTP(S), local files, IPTV M3U, external subtitles and safe favourites. Does not replace TV360 playback.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Optional Analytics Privacy
Sets optional Firebase Analytics and Facebook automatic event collection opt-outs.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Optional Crash Reports Privacy
Disables automatic Firebase Crashlytics collection via manifest metadata.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Pure AMOLED Black
Makes verified dark TV360 interface surfaces #000000 while retaining text, red accents, posters and video.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Sensor Rotation
Allows the main activity to follow the device sensor in portrait and landscape.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Sensor Rotation (Runtime)
Applies device-sensor rotation to the home activity's three verified orientation requests.
TV360 Bitel 1.6 - Video Resize (Fit / Fill)
Select FIT (no crop) or FILL (crop-to-fill) in Morphe before rebuilding the APK; not a runtime player menu.
